title: RIG / 3090 — Anatomy of a Rig
description: A cinematic, scroll-driven exploration of a real four-RTX-3090 rig. The original Blender photo reconstruction becomes 22 movable component groups: graphics cards, cooling, motherboard, power supplies and hand-built supports. Scroll to take it apart, explore close-ups and put it back together. Reverse scrolling reverses the animation.
